note: Rewritten from Emerson 1925, original in English (The termites of Kartabo, Bartica District, British Guiana, Zoologica 6(4)). The original restates the accounts of Holmgren 1906 (p. 543, soldier, worker) and Holmgren 1912 (p. 86, soldier) and adds material from Kartabo, British Guiana: the description is based on several alates, 1 queen and numerous soldiers collected by the author in four different colonies at Kartabo; the type locality is Tuiche (Prov. Caupolican), Bolivia, and the new record is British Guiana. The original did not describe the worker (it only quotes Holmgren's worker account). The measurement tables are badly damaged by OCR: in the alate table the labels of the first 3 rows are destroyed, and only the values 0.96–1.00 mm and 0.86–0.87 mm are legible but cannot be matched to characters (so they are not recorded); in the soldier table the value for "Length of pronotum" is missing and the first half of the head width row is mixed with noise (read from context); the figure of the head and mandibles in fig. 82 is not translated.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule medium dark brown with a white punctate texture, oval, the sides arched between the compound eyes; covered with dense short hairs and numerous setae. The fontanelle spot is small and round, slightly paler than the head capsule. The muscle impressions are not very distinct. The compound eyes are of medium size and not close to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are of medium size, about their own width away from the compound eye. The labrum is pale yellow. The postclypeus is slightly paler than the frons, its midline invisible; the suture between the frons and the postclypeus is extremely indistinct. The shape of the mandibles is shown in the original figure (fig. 82, c). The pronotum is slightly paler than the head capsule, with a Y-shaped row of pale spots in the middle; long and narrow, the sides rounded and slightly concave, the posterior margin deeply concave. The posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum are incised. All the tibiae bear 3 apical spurs. The wings are smoky with distinct veins; the media lies close to the cubitus and has 2–4 branches; the cubitus has 9–12 branches. The abdominal tergites are slightly paler than the head capsule. Measurements: length with wings 7.50–8.00 mm; length without wings 5.00–5.30 mm; antennal length 1.27–1.80 mm; diameter of the compound eye 0.27 mm; pronotum length 0.43–0.45 mm; pronotum width 0.60–0.63 mm; hind tibia length 0.73 mm; forewing length 6.54 mm; forewing width 1.30 mm; queen length 10.00 mm; queen abdominal width 1.50 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, slightly darker anteriorly, covered with short setae; the head is very long, with parallel sides and a rounded posterior margin. The antennae have 11 segments, segment 3 sometimes showing a tendency to split. The mandibles are reddish brown, short and curved, with acute tips, with 1 tooth near the base, the right and left mandibles very similar. The opening of the frontal gland is present, very small, situated between the bases of the two antennae. The pronotum is pale yellow, covered with short setae; the anterior lobe is distinct and weakly concave in the middle. The legs are pale yellow, the fore tibia with 3 apical spurs, the other tibiae with 2 apical spurs each. The abdomen is pale yellow; the tergites are covered with short hairs and numerous longer setae. Measurements: body length 3.46–4.40 mm; head with mandibles 2.01–2.33 mm; head width 0.77–0.87 mm (the first half of this row in the original table is mixed with OCR noise); antennal length 0.90–1.03 mm; pronotum width 0.57–0.61 mm; hind tibia length 0.57–0.63 mm; length of the left mandible 0.65–0.75 mm.
